countries.summary: Ireland's energy regulator, the CRU, published its Large Energy Users Connection Policy on 12 December 2025, governing grid connection for data centres. EirGrid's May 2026 overview says the greater Dublin region is fully constrained, and a South Dublin council refused a Google data centre in 2024 over electricity-network concerns.

countries.summary: France's Île-de-France region adopted a data-centre siting strategy on 25 June 2026 seeking more local benefit. A 75 MW Segro project at Le Bourget faces a new mayor's opposition and an environmental-authority query on waste-heat recovery. A national heat-recovery obligation exists but its decree is not yet verified.

Québec requires government authorization before projects of 5 MW or more can connect, and Hydro-Québec has applied to the Régie de l'énergie (docket R-4333-2026) for a dedicated data-centre rate. The Google Beauharnois project was announced in 2021 with no status update found.

context.statement: Hydro-Québec proposes a large data-centre rate averaging 13¢/kWh, about double what current large-power customers pay.
context.verbatim: equivalent to an average of 13¢/kWh, approximately double what current large-power customers pay
context.source_title: Hydro-Québec — Proposing a new rate for large data centres

countries.summary: Singapore's EDB and IMDA provisionally allocated 200 MW of new data-centre capacity in DC-CFA2, 50 MW each to four operators, with green-energy conditions. The country also had a de facto approval pause from 2019 to 2022 that is not yet verified to the bar for a moratorium record.

countries.summary: The Energy Efficiency Directive's data-centre reporting rules are in force, and the Commission proposed the Cloud and AI Development Act on 3 June 2026 (COM(2026) 502), which is not yet law.

The UK government's AI Growth Zones policy paper proposes grid-capacity reservation and electricity-cost discounts for data centres in designated zones. The Nscale Loughton scheme drew objections from the town council over cooling and energy demand.
